professionalSummary.text: Three‑year project manager on a bank’s wealth platform onboarding programme, leading regional projects under the delivery framework.
professionalSummary.witness: Project manager on a bank's wealth platform onboarding programme for three years, running the onboarding projects for two regions under the bank's delivery framework with their migration plans and adviser training schedules.

professionalSummary.text: Steered senior advisers through migration, resolving 58 objections and ensuring on‑schedule onboarding.
professionalSummary.witness: Steered the two regions' senior advisers through the migration under the programme's adviser engagement plan; the engagement log records the fifty‑eight adviser objections raised, the resolution of each, and the two regions' migration completed with every adviser onboarded on schedule.

professionalSummary.text: Prepared weekly steering reports and managed dependencies with platform vendor and adviser operations.
professionalSummary.witness: Prepared the weekly steering report for the head of wealth change and managed the dependencies with the platform vendor and adviser operations through the framework's dependency log.

professionalSummary.text: Prepared migration readiness reviews with go‑ahead from regional wealth directors, documenting responsibility boundaries.
professionalSummary.witness: Prepared the migration readiness review for each migration wave; the go‑ahead was the regional wealth director's, recorded on the review together with which checks were mine and which were adviser operations'.

professionalSummary.text: Authored closure reports with project boundaries and client migration evidence accepted by the programme office.
professionalSummary.witness: Wrote the closure report for each region with the project boundary statement and the client migration evidence accepted by the programme office.
